name: Domingo Pérez de Granada (Spain)
description: Yellow field with a blue wavy fess charged with a white wavy line, a red pillar with two castles above and a green holm oak with a red boar below.
history: Domingo Pérez de Granada adopted its arms and flag officially on 2 June 2005, while still an autonomous local entity, and they were ratified without modification as a municipality on 22 March 2019; the flag is a cloth of 2:3, yellow, with a blue wavy fess charged with a white wavy line, accompanied above by a tall red pillar with two castles.

features.role: wavy fess charged with a white wavy line
tall pillar with two castles above the fess
holm oak with a red boar beneath
